description: List the banks Koywe supports for a LATAM country, used when registering a third-party or first-party bank account that requires an explicit bank code (Colombia/PSE, Chile/CLP_BANK, Bolivia/BOB_BANK). Each bank entry has: name (human label), value (Koywe entity code — pass back as bankCode), and domain (for logo display). Mexico/Argentina/Peru also return banks but those rails resolve the bank from the account number automatically.

countrySymbol.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Supported: MX, AR, PE, BR, CO, CL, BO.

name: list_banks_for_country
